notes.title: Castle of Heart: Retold ⚔ Coming October 3rd!
notes.notes:
[p]The wait is almost over! ⚔💔⚔[/p][p]On [b]October 3, 2025[/b], [i]Castle of Heart: Retold[/i] will finally arrive on Steam.[/p][p]We’ve taken the original 2018 release and rebuilt it with:[/p][list][*][p]🎨 Revamped visuals[/p][/*][*][p]⚔ Enhanced gameplay and controls[/p][/*][*][p]📖 A reimagined story[/p][/*][*][p]💥 More action, more heart[/p][/*][/list][p]Check out the side-by-side shots below to see how far the game has come:
⏳ [b]2018 – the original journey[/b]
🆕 [b]2025 – the Retold edition[/b][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628745/35a5c55fc9cae827267bd421644e4cffc7c196ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628745/7ca228e6eedd3de3202fe433f6a189265c5e1c94.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628745/151947c883c01dfef18ab396d2620fb1683f6366.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628745/0de1b3dfddf4261c2c446f618ce36c09e1d8ed19.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628745/65a353098a0a095f8c43ec8ca89bd0490d28c38f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628745/17f1dde0dbbde6ce19c10b4387543884693020d9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628745/c70ff03162dc108225910c548ed29bb71de618b7.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Make sure it’s on your Wishlist so you don’t miss the release.[/p][p][/p]
